thread:
Alex: quick idea — prototype a compact 'Permission Summary' card for tenant admin panels that shows effective roles, route quotas, and routing tier (hosted/dedicated/private). thoughts?
Maria: +1. Can we also surface telemetry signals — last 24h token usage, quota burn rate, and recent perm-related errors? :bar_chart: 
TJ: curious about API shape. Suggest returning effective_principals[], sample:
```
GET /v1/admin/tenants/:id/perm-summary
{
  "roles": ["tenant_admin", "read_only"],
  "routes": [{"path": "/v1/generate", "quota": 100000, "used": 23456, "routing_tier": "dedicated"}],
  "last_24h_tokens": 123456
}
```
Maria: that looks fine. add `quota_reset_at` and `audit_link` to each route
Katie: UX note — show a compact badge for 'quota near limit' and an inline 'request increase' CTA. Also how do we handle delegated admin scopes?
Samir: security note — make sure the preview respects scope filtering (no leakage). Also ensure every action links to an audit event id.
Alex: agree re: audit. For rollout: canary to 10% tenants, opt-in flag `perm_summary_v1`. Need console telemetry to record impressions + CTA clicks.
deploy-bot: canary created: flag=perm_summary_v1 rollout=10% started by Alex
TJ: backend TODOs: new endpoint, caching TTL 5m, evaluate prefix cache for KV tokens. Telemetry events: perm_summary.view, perm_summary.request_increase, perm_summary.audit_open
Maria: will wire metrics dashboards — add per-route burn_rate and p50/p95 latency for permission checks.
Katie: can we show an 'Effective access' hover so admins see why a role grants/denies a route? tiny animation ok. :sparkles:
Samir: also add enterprise controls toggle (enforce_org_policies) and show a warning if enabled.
Alex: plan: I'll open a PR with UI mock + API contract tomorrow. If no blockers we'll start canary next week. :thumbsup:
TJ: I'll pick up backend PR after lunch.
Maria: ping me for dashboard names, I'll create a grafana panel id.
Alex: cool — thanks everyone.
